key_terms.الْأَعْلَى: The highest, superlative form indicating the utmost degree or position.
key_terms.الْأُفُقِ: The horizon or boundary of the sky, often used in cosmological contexts to denote the limits of the visible world.

ai.seo_question: What does the 'highest pinnacle' (al-Ufuq al-A'la) refer to in Surah An-Najm?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) receiving divine revelation or attaining the station of 'Wahy' at the highest horizon, distinct from the lower horizon of the first descent. This moment signifies the culmination of his spiritual journey and his unique role as the perfect conduit of God's will, reinforcing the concept of his infallibility and closeness to the Divine Essence.
